summary.name: Things
summary.one_liner: Things is a personal task manager from Cultured Code for planning your day, organizing projects, and tracking progress toward goals.
use_cases: to-do list on iPhone and iPad
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Things as a personal task manager for planning the day, managing projects, and working toward goals, from routine tasks to larger life goals. Reviewers quoted on the page praise its design, fast sync, keyboard shortcuts, and Markdown notes in projects and tasks. It has native support for Apple Shortcuts, according to one quoted review. The page states the app has won two Apple Design Awards and was described by reviewers as working on iPad and iPhone as well as Mac.
notable: Markdown notes in projects and tasks
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Platform availability is inferred from reviewer quotes rather than a full platform list
